tee_shift.note: The game tee was moved 50 yd forward along the hole for the OpenFairway physics (docs/holes/standrews-17.md §6): every z in the HOLES entry is 50 yd less than this frame gives (the sheds, their collider and the hotel moved with the tee). Subtract 50 from z in lidar.py output before pasting it into the hole.

lidar.source: Scottish Public Sector LiDAR Phase 5, 50 cm DTM, tiles NO41NE_50CM_DTM_PHASE5.tif and NO51NW_50CM_DTM_PHASE5.tif (Open Government Licence v3), from srsp-open-data.s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com (lidar/phase-5/dtm/27700/gridded/). Not in the repo (383 + 206 MB)
lidar.crs: EPSG:27700 (British National Grid), heights ODN m
lidar.located_by: map pins from the project owner on the green (56.343195, -2.808815), placed at the game pin (18, 470), and on the back tee by the Old Course Hotel (56.345991, -2.813011)

frame.why: tee -> pin is 405.1 m at 140.9 degrees (the owner's two pins; both yardage pages put the green south-east of the hotel tee); the game's tee -> pin is 470 yd with the pin 18 yd left, so +z is 2.2 degrees right of that line and yd_per_m = 470.3 / 405.1
